channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Zaccharie Risacher | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Zaccharie Risacher from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Buddy Hield on Zaccharie Risacher
item.description:
Buddy Hield, on Zaccharie Risacher:

“You just use this test, turn this into testimony. And when you look back on it in three or four years, you’ll be like, ‘Man, I've been in the fire for a reason.’“And I think he's going to get all of that, and I tell him that he's going to have a summer where – whether he's in LA or Miami, where he's not going back to Europe – he's staying here and he's going to play a lot of basketball and he's going to work on his game and he's going to get a lot better.”

Buddy Hield on Zaccharie Risacher, May 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Trae Young on Zaccharie Risacher
item.description:
Haynes also noted that a potential deal involving the Hawks would not include Trae Young, with the Mavericks likely focusing on the Hawks’ former first overall pick.

“If a deal was to materialize ... I was told it would not involve Trae Young. Dallas would likely want expiring deals, young assets, and picks — and probably, likely to include last season's number one pick, Zaccharie Risacher,”

Trae Young on Zaccharie Risacher, Dec 27, 2025. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Devin Booker on Zaccharie Risacher
item.description:
Devin Booker on play stoppage after Zaccharie Risacher hard fall in 124-122 Suns loss to Hawks:

“I hope he's OK, but the situation is they can't call that play dead when we have advantage numbers. I've never seen it happen before and then give a tech for us calling it out. It's a compound mistake by the refs and they just have to be better.”

Devin Booker on Zaccharie Risacher, Nov 17, 2025. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Tony Parker on Victor Wembanyama, Rayan Rupert, Zaccharie Risacher
item.description:
“Of course! As a point guard, I’d have loved playing with Victor. I think we could’ve won multiple golds for France. With the new generation coming in—players like Rayan Rupert and Zaccharie Risacher—I think we’ll have a great team by 2028. Hopefully, we’ll continue competing with the U.S.”

Tony Parker on Victor Wembanyama, Rayan Rupert, Zaccharie Risacher, Jan 22, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Bogdan Bogdanovic, De'Andre Hunter, Dyson Daniels, Zaccharie Risacher
item.description:
Hawks coach Quin Snyder said Saturday.

“So, I don’t look at it as a positional thing where (we) talk about backup this. It’s the same way you look at a wing. Dyson (Daniels) is not Hunt’s (De’Andre Hunter) backup, Zacch’s (Zaccharie Risacher) not Dyson’s backup. Bogi’s (Bogdan Bogdanovic) not Zacch’s backup. Like you have players, and the most important thing is (how) the team functions. And that means, when I say functions, it’s successful.”

Quin Snyder on Bogdan Bogdanovic, De'Andre Hunter, Dyson Daniels, Zaccharie Risacher, Oct 19, 2024. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.
